criteria.quote: Golduck: fastest swimmer, rescuer from wrecked ships.
criteria.revision: Replace the opening with: "If Golduck is the fastest swimmer among Pokémon, why do its entries keep escalating from races to rough seas to shipwrecks?" This creates a concrete question using only the documented feats.

criteria.quote: Golduck's official profile combines champion-beating speed, storm swimming, endurance, and rescue work.
criteria.revision: Change the title to "Golduck Is Faster Than Any Human Champion—and Swims Rough Seas" to foreground two specific Pokédex claims instead of the vague phrase "when it matters."

criteria.quote: Is Golduck's speed just a claim, or does it change what swimming means?
criteria.revision: Replace the open loop with: "If Golduck is faster than every human swimming champion, can its real advantage be its ability to keep swimming through rough seas and for two days straight?" This gives the viewer a concrete comparison to track.

criteria.quote: FASTEST AND A RESCUER; FASTER THAN ANY CHAMPION; FAST FISH STILL STOP; STORMS DON'T SLOW IT; IT KEEPS GOING
criteria.revision: Do not reveal both the speed and rescue claims in the first scene. Start with the human-champion claim, then move through stopping fast-swimming fish, rough seas, and two-day endurance, saving the shipwreck rescue for the final factual reveal.

criteria.quote: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can end up completely motionless.
criteria.revision: Move this reveal after the human-champion comparison and frame it as a change in what Golduck's speed does: "Golduck isn't only faster than fast swimmers—it can bring fast-swimming fish Pokémon to a standstill."

criteria.quote: FASTEST AND A RESCUER; FASTER THAN ANY CHAMPION
criteria.revision: Rewrite the first scene so it teases the angle without repeating the second scene: "Golduck's swimming record gets stranger the more you read." Then let the next scene deliver the specific human-champion claim.

criteria.quote: Champion speed, storm endurance: fastest swimmer, or greatest rescuer?
criteria.revision: End with a factual synthesis before the question: "Golduck is described as faster than any human swimming champion, able to swim through rough seas for two days, and sometimes able to rescue people from wrecked ships." This resolves the speed promise with the full range of documented evidence.

criteria.quote: Is Golduck the fastest swimmer, or the greatest rescuer?
criteria.revision: Replace it with: "Which defines Golduck more: being the fastest swimmer among Pokémon, or being able to swim through rough seas and sometimes rescue people from wrecked ships?" This creates a genuine interpretive split without claiming it is the greatest rescuer.
